input.message:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out. Yes, you can export invoices in bulk:

1. Go to Billing > Invoices.
2. Filter the date range to 1 January 2025 – 31 December 2025.
3. Choose Export > PDF archive.

This gives you all of the 2025 invoices as PDFs in one archive, ready to send to your accountant. The linked article has more detail.

If anything doesn't look right, just let us know.

Best regards,
Helpline Support

final_text:
I've saved a draft reply for HL-1002 (draft #1). It hasn't been sent and is waiting for your review. I didn't escalate it.

- **The ticket:** Brightleaf Foods (Team plan) wants all of their 2025 invoices as PDFs for their accountant. It's a normal-priority how-to question and the status is pending.
- **What I found:** knowledge-base article KB-102, "Export invoices in bulk," covers this: go to Billing > Invoices, filter by date range, then choose Export > PDF archive. There are no other tickets like this one.
- **The draft:** it gives those steps with the date range set to 1 January – 31 December 2025, and links KB-102.

Before sending, check that the Team plan can use the bulk PDF export. The part of the article I could see doesn't say which plans have it.
